title: Sindh Local Government Elections Amendment Ordinance 2000

sections.shortTitle: Sindh Local Government Elections Amendment Ordinance 2000
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ORDINANCE XIII OF 2000
SINDH LOCAL
GOVERNMENT ELECTIONS (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 2000
ORDINANCE XIII OF
2000
An Ordinance to
amend the Sindh Local Government Elections Ordinance, 2000
[Gazette of Sindh,
Extraordinary; Part I, 14th November, 2000]
No. S.LEGIS.1(13)/2000, dated 14-11-2000. The
following Ordinance made by the Governor of Sindh is hereby published fur
general information:--
1. Short title and
commencement. ---(1) This Ordinance may be called the Sindh Local
Government Elections (Amendment) Ordinance, 2000.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

amend the Sindh Local Government Elections Ordinance, 2000
[Gazette of Sindh,
Extraordinary; Part I, 14th November, 2000]
No. S.LEGIS.1(13)/2000, dated 14-11-2000. The
following Ordinance made by the Governor of Sindh is hereby published fur
general information:--
2. Amendment of section 3 of
Sindh Ordinance No. X of 2000.---In the Sindh Local Government Elections
Ordinance, 2000, hereinafter referred to as the said Ordinance, in section 3,
in subsection (1), in clause (b), sub -clause (i), after the word
"delis", the commas and the words or in the case of areas where
settlement of lands under the Sindh Land Revenue Act, 1967, has not taken
place, one or more population census villages," shall be added.

sections.shortTitle: Sindh Local Government Elections Amendment Ordinance 2000
sections.description:
Amendment of section 9 of Sindh Ordinance No. X of 2000

ORDINANCE XIII OF 2000
SINDH LOCAL
GOVERNMENT ELECTIONS (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 2000
ORDINANCE XIII OF
2000
An Ordinance to
amend the Sindh Local Government Elections Ordinance, 2000
[Gazette of Sindh,
Extraordinary; Part I, 14th November, 2000]
No. S.LEGIS.1(13)/2000, dated 14-11-2000. The
following Ordinance made by the Governor of Sindh is hereby published fur
general information:--
5. Amendment of section 9 of
Sindh Ordinance No. X of 2000.---In the said Ordinance; for section 9, the
following shall be substituted, namely:-
"9. Special
minority seats.--In a local area where the population of minorities is in
excess of ten percent. of the total population of that area, the seats
mentioned in the preceding sections shall be allocated in such manner as the
Government may determine."
